title: The Complete Carebrush™ Curly To Coily
text: Performance matters Looking for a brush that does it all? Our next generation The Complete Carebrush™ is all about maximum benefits with minimal effort. It smooths, shines, massages and detangles in one easy step. Designed to work with curly to coily hair, not against it, the brush features our latest hair innovation – new next generation teeth technology, designed for hair flow. Arranged diagonally, the patent-pending, two-tiered firm-flex teeth allow hair to glide through the brush with minimal resistance. Extra-long, oval-shaped teeth help guide the flow of hair, smoothing the cuticle for added shine while gently massaging the scalp to support scalp health. Meanwhile, shorter triangular teeth effortlessly detangle to help minimise breakage. Sometimes bigger really is better. A larger brush head covers more hair with every stroke, while the elevated matte-and-gloss finish brings a premium feel. Perfect for both wet and dry hair, it's unlike any brush you've used before. Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat to maintain its performance! Together with The Complete Carebrush™, enjoy shinier hair and complete hair health.

title: The Ultimate Detangler Extra Gentle
text: Have a lot of hair fall or locks prone to breakage, and worry about brushing your hair? The Ultimate Detangler Extra Gentle is the hairbrush for you. The innovative and unique wide-spaced teeth pattern is extra gentle on delicate hair, and it’s designed to minimise breakage and hair fall. There are fewer teeth at the edges of the brush to minimise tension on hair, and in the centre the teeth are more concentrated giving effortless detangling that’s extra-gentle. Learn more here . Check out our trichologist backed downloadable resource here on why the Extra Gentle is for you. Inspired by the world of sensitive skin and nature, choose from calming Chamomile Yellow, brightening Saffron, and soothing Eucalyptus Green. Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat! Together with the Ultimate Detangler Extra Gentle enjoy less hair fall, less breakage, and more confidence. *219 UK & US female respondents after two weeks (2025)

title: The Ultimate Detangler Plant Brush™
text: Designed differently, to perform brilliantly It’s innovative, it’s revolutionary, it’s plant-based; say hello to the Ultimate Detangler Plant Brush™. The next generation of Tangle Teezer, it’s the same detangling power you know and love in our Ultimate design, but made out of 85% sustainably sourced castor beans. Long story short, we took the beans and turned them into a high-performing, long-lasting eco hairbrush that will leave you with smoother and healthier-looking hair. Plant-based doesn’t mean you have to compromise on quality - not on our watch - because the Plant Brush™ still features our unique two-tiered teeth technology, designed to effortlessly detangle and care for your hair. It’s a stroke of genius and a stroke of good. Kinder to the planet? Check. Fully recyclable*? Check. Same Tangle Teezer touch? CHECK! Learn more about the Plant Brush™ here . HOT TIP: Keep this brush away from heat! Together with the Plant Brush™, enjoy smoother and healthier-looking hair. *Via our Recycling Programme. Find out more here

title: The Scalp Exfoliator & Massager
text: The multi-tasking marvel Our first foray into wellness, the Scalp Exfoliator & Massager is the TLC-giving tool you need to add to your hair care ritual. The Scalp Exfoliator & Massage is designed to help detox the scalp. Featuring dual-teeth, it scrubs away product build-up, dead skin cells and dirt, while stimulating blood flow to the scalp and giving you a relaxing massage. The winged design uniquely fits all hand sizes without slipping - even in water. Use in-shower while shampooing to get that scalp squeaky clean, or use it by itself or with oil on dry hair to indulge in a little self-care. Together with the Scalp Exfoliator & Massager, care for your scalp and care for you. Want to learn more? Check out our blog The Benefits of a Scalp Brush

title: Hair Pick
text: Turn the volume up Serious volume and lift is yours, thanks to the Hair Pick. Designed for natural 3C-4C hair, the unique, long bottle-shaped teeth are gentle but impactful. Reaching deep into the root of the hair, the teeth are durable, sturdy and provide more coverage to help speed up the styling process. Gliding through the hair with less pulling and snagging, they help reduce breakage, while the lightweight design and ergonomic handle makes it a breeze to use. Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat! *Not suitable for detangling. But we can help you with that too. Together with the Hair Pick, get easy, speedy and snag-free volume.

title: The Ultimate Volumizer
text: For chasing heights Back-combing gets a bad rep, but with our carefully designed Ultimate Volumizer , you can get the height, texture and long-lasting volume you want with minimal damage and breakage. We’re all about unique two-tiered technology and t he Ultimate Volumizer is no exception. With greater density of teeth at the base, it makes back-combing quicker, easier and much gentler on your hair. Due to its gentle nature, it’s suitable for all hair types and lengths - how you use it is up to you. Together with the Ultimate Volumizer , create height, texture and volume.

title: The Ultimate Styler
text: For the finishing touches Designed to dry-style and effortlessly finish any look, the Ultimate Styler is your new best friend. With unique bottle-shaped teeth, it gently brushes out curls, maintains and blends hair extensions, clip-ins and weaves and leaves your hair with a smooth and shiny finish. Its thin and comfortable handle gives you maximum control when creating chic updos or adding volume and texture. Perfect for all hair types, let it work its magic. *Please remember! This brush is not suitable for detangling. Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat! Together with the Ultimate Styler, finish any look flawlessly.

title: The Ultimate Blow Dry
text: For the ultimate at-home blow-dry A salon-quality blow-dry from the comfort of your own home? The Ultimate Blow Dry is here to show you the light. Natural volume, lift, shine and smoothness is yours and has never been easier. Ideal for fine to medium hair types, the patented bottle-shaped teeth technology and unique configuration works together with the vent to quickly dry the hair, cutting down on time and damage. If you’re looking for a fuss and frizz-free blow-dry, you’ve found it. The Regular Ultimate Blow Dry brush is ideal for fine to medium hair types, while the Large Ultimate Blow Dry is for hair that’s thick and curly. Learn how to get the best out of your new blow dry brush here . *This brush isn’t for detangling. But we can help you with that too. Together with the Ultimate Blow Dry, get the blowout of your life.

title: Smoothing Tool
text: Smooth in every way Not just pros in detangling, we also have the tools you need to perfect your blow-dry at home and the Smoothing Tool is the innovative blow-drying hairbrush that’ll do just that. Taking the hair from wet to dry and leaving it beautifully smooth, it has overlapping fixed base teeth with built-in tension and flexibility at the tips. Giving you a quick and gentle blow-dry with no pulling or stretch-drying, this size is the perfect smoothing brush for medium to long hair lengths. *Not suitable for detangling. But we can help you with that too. Together with the Full Size Smoothing Tool, up your blow-drying game.

title: Compact Styler
text: The handbag must-have The only thing you need in your bag (apart from your keys and wallet), is the Compact Styler. When it comes to styling on-the-go it’ll always have your back, meaning no hat, gust of wind or rainy day will ever dampen your spirits again. Ideal for fine to medium hair types, its two-tiered flexible teeth are protected by a click-on cover and will gently glide through your hair adding a smooth, shiny finish wherever you are. Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat! Together with the Compact Styler, detangle on-the-go.

title: Wide Tooth Comb
text: This one’s for the curls Developed with the curly-haired community, the Wide Tooth Comb is an innovative, dual-sided comb designed to quickly and confidently detangle 3C-4C hair. The long, sturdy teeth with soft, rounded tips effortlessly glide through the hair with less pulling, help speed up the detangling process and reduce breakage, while the flexible two-tiered teeth provide a deeper detangle to help remove shed hair and stubborn knots, leaving your pattern popping. Easy to use and comfortable to hold, it’ll leave natural curls beautifully defined. Effective on wet, damp or dry hair, the Wide Tooth Comb can also be used to draw products through the hair, meaning healthier-looking, softer curls that are easier to maintain. Let’s bounce!. Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat! Together with the Wide Tooth Comb, defined and detangled curls with less breakage are yours.

title: The Ultimate Detangler Naturally Curly
text: Calling all curls Gone are the days of long (sometimes painful) detangling sessions. Instead, enjoy an easier wash day with the help of our Naturally Curly Ultimate Detangler. Created with curls in mind, this detangling hairbrush was made for anyone with 3C to 4C hair types. The longer, firmer teeth are kind to curls but tough on tangles and the shorter teeth help to reduce the level of frizz, while keeping the curls defined. Designed for use on wet hair, our innovative teeth technology can cut detangling time in half* - you could give your locks a treatment with the saved time. Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat! *Self-assessment of 102 women after 2 weeks of use Together with the Naturally Curly Ultimate Detangler, detangle your curls easily and quickly.

title: The Ultimate Detangler Fine & Fragile
text: It’s a soft touch Our bestselling Ultimate Detangler, engineered for Fine & Fragile hair. The same winning features, but with soft-flex teeth that are a grade softer than our original Ultimate Detangler, it was created with fine, fragile, heat-damaged or colour-treated hair in mind. Tough on knots, but gentle to sensitive scalps come shower time, this is delicate detangling at its finest. HOT TIP: Keep this hairbrush away from heat Together with the Fine & Fragile Ultimate Detangler, expect less breakage and pulling, but more TLC.

title: The Original Thick & Curly

Designed for thick, curly, textured and afro hair, it quickly and easily detangles wet or dry hair with its two-tiered firm-flex teeth. Longer and stronger than our other hairbrushes, these teeth are ready to sink into your crowning glory. HOT TIP: Keep this hairbrush away from heat Together with the Thick & Curly Original, leave your curls tangle-free and super defined.

title: The Original Fine & Fragile
text: Gently does it Detangling your vulnerable hair doesn’t have to be scary and our Fine & Fragile detangling brush is here to take the fear out of it. Designed for colour-treated, fine or fragile hair, its two-tiered soft-flex teeth glides from root to tip with no pulling and less breakage, meaning you can confidently detangle knowing your hair is in safe hands. Well, teeth. P.S. these teeth are 30% softer than The Original and are super gentle on wet or dry hair HOT TIP: Keep this hairbrush away from heat Together with the Fine & Fragile Original, go easy on your hair.

title: The Original Mini
text: Good things come in small packages A mini version of our award-winning detangling hairbrush The Original, The Mini may be small in size, but it’s big on detangling. Perfect for little hands, it detangles wet or dry hair with its two-tiered regular-flex teeth. Gliding through the hair with no pulling or tugging, it’ll leave you with super smooth and tangle-free locks. HOT TIP: Keep this hairbrush away from heat! Together with the Mini Original, introduce the world of detangling to your little one.

title: The Original
text: The Cult Classic Our first born, the Original is the multi award-winning hairbrush that started it all. Ideal for straight-to-wavy hair types, our patented two-tiered teeth technology is the star of the show. Gliding through wet and dry hair, the long teeth detangle, while the shorter teeth smooth the hair cuticle. The results are smooth and healthier-looking hair with increased shine and no tugging or pulling. 81% agree they had healthier-looking hair* (Based on a self assessment test of 187 women using the Pink Fizz Original) Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat Together with the Original, detangling is a breeze.

title: The Ultimate Detangler
text: It’s a fan favourite Designed for use on wet hair and in the shower, The Ultimate Detangler effortlessly slips through your hair (and thanks to its handle, not out of your wet hands). The patented two-tiered teeth technology is gentle on vulnerable, shower-fresh hair, meaning less breakage, more of that running-your-fingers-through-your-hair feeling. The long teeth detangle, while the shorter teeth smooth - a team effort at its finest. Treating your locks to a conditioning treatment? Use The Ultimate Detangler to evenly draw your products of choice through the lengths of your hair. If you have long, thick or curly hair, let us redirect you to The Large Ultimate Detangler. Sometimes size does matter. The mini Ultimate Detangler is perfect for travel with a savvy keyring hole on the handle. Although small, it confidently detangles any type of hair, helping to reduce hair breakage. The mini size doesn’t mean it’s just great for kids. It’s perfect for adults too! Hot tip: Keep this hairbrush away from heat! Together with the Ultimate Detangler, avoid breakage and enjoy smooth, detangled hair.
